pubcol-w-e84599215c611784.definition_en: continuing forward from a particular point in time or place
pubcol-w-e84599215c611784.example_simple: From next week on, we will start earlier.
pubcol-w-e84599215c611784.example_complex: The rules apply from the date of signing on, so any earlier agreements no longer count.
pubcol-w-e84599215c611784.vi_meaning_correction: tiếp tục từ (một thời điểm hoặc vị trí); về sau

e0816b18-0d94-4195-a02e-3a164f59d9e8.definition_en: for reasons that do not involve protection or self-defence

pubcol-w-2071bddee2de6355.definition_en: bought by paying in regular instalments over time rather than all at once
pubcol-w-2071bddee2de6355.example_simple: They bought the sofa on hire purchase.
pubcol-w-2071bddee2de6355.example_complex: Because they couldn't afford it outright, the couple acquired the car on hire purchase and paid it off over three years.

pubcol-w-987ff0a8c18fb76a.definition_en: currently taking medicine prescribed for an illness or condition
pubcol-w-987ff0a8c18fb76a.example_simple: She is on medication for her blood pressure.
pubcol-w-987ff0a8c18fb76a.example_complex: While he was on medication for anxiety, the doctor advised him to avoid alcohol entirely.

pubcol-w-f1c8b61534228a3c.definition_en: watchful and ready for possible danger or trouble
pubcol-w-f1c8b61534228a3c.example_simple: Be on your guard when strangers offer you help.
pubcol-w-f1c8b61534228a3c.example_complex: Investors should remain on their guard against schemes that promise unusually high returns.

pubcol-w-04a56203b68ea0f4.definition_en: anxious or nervous while waiting for something to happen
pubcol-w-04a56203b68ea0f4.example_simple: I was on pins and needles waiting for my exam results.
pubcol-w-04a56203b68ea0f4.example_complex: The whole family sat on pins and needles as the surgeon finally emerged to give them news.

pubcol-w-d0aefa48624f0fb4.definition_en: provided or done only when someone specifically asks for it
pubcol-w-d0aefa48624f0fb4.example_simple: A vegetarian meal is available on request.
pubcol-w-d0aefa48624f0fb4.example_complex: Detailed references from previous employers will be supplied on request during the hiring process.

pubcol-w-9be1393dfdafa0f6.definition_en: offered for purchase, often at a reduced price
pubcol-w-9be1393dfdafa0f6.example_simple: These shoes are on sale this week.
pubcol-w-9be1393dfdafa0f6.example_complex: The new smartphone goes on sale on Friday, and early buyers can get it on sale at a substantial discount.

pubcol-w-e4a6db0b21d396fa.definition_en: printed on the final page of a newspaper or magazine
collocations: the story on the back page
pubcol-w-e4a6db0b21d396fa.example_simple: The football results are on the back page.
pubcol-w-e4a6db0b21d396fa.example_complex: The scandal was buried on the back page, while a lighter story dominated the front.

pubcol-w-dcfbfdd66b4dc327.definition_en: very close to the outbreak of war
collocations: bring a country on the brink of war
teeter on the brink of war
nations on the brink of war
pubcol-w-dcfbfdd66b4dc327.example_simple: The two countries were on the brink of war.
pubcol-w-dcfbfdd66b4dc327.example_complex: After the border incident, the region stood on the brink of war until diplomats brokered a fragile ceasefire.

pubcol-w-84520ed972fb3257.definition_en: considering the other or opposite aspect of a situation
collocations: on the flip side of that
pubcol-w-84520ed972fb3257.example_simple: The job pays well; on the flip side, the hours are long.
pubcol-w-84520ed972fb3257.example_complex: Remote work offers flexibility, but on the flip side it can blur the line between professional and personal life.

pubcol-w-6e4a2b929a6aebb1.definition_en: for the stated reason or on the stated basis
pubcol-w-6e4a2b929a6aebb1.example_simple: The claim was refused on the grounds that it was late.
pubcol-w-6e4a2b929a6aebb1.example_complex: The court dismissed the appeal on the grounds of insufficient evidence rather than any procedural error.

pubcol-w-6a5a271c66269d43.definition_en: in the final stage of a task or journey, close to finishing
pubcol-w-6a5a271c66269d43.example_simple: We're on the home stretch of the project.
pubcol-w-6a5a271c66269d43.example_complex: With only the conclusion left to write, she felt she was finally on the home stretch of her thesis.

pubcol-w-ccef42fff7a2dd56.definition_en: forced to choose between two equally unpleasant options
collocations: caught on the horns of a dilemma
leave someone on the horns of a dilemma
stuck on the horns of a dilemma
pubcol-w-ccef42fff7a2dd56.example_simple: He was on the horns of a dilemma about which job to take.
pubcol-w-ccef42fff7a2dd56.example_complex: The government found itself on the horns of a dilemma: raise taxes and lose votes, or cut services and provoke outrage.

pubcol-w-f542065acd6ede56.definition_en: given free of charge by a business, especially a bar or restaurant
pubcol-w-f542065acd6ede56.example_simple: The manager said our coffee was on the house.
pubcol-w-f542065acd6ede56.example_complex: To apologise for the long wait, the restaurant offered every table a dessert on the house.

pubcol-w-856ecce135a89ce0.definition_en: in the outer areas surrounding a city, away from its centre
synonyms: on the edge of the city
on the fringes of the city
collocations: live on the outskirts of the city
pubcol-w-856ecce135a89ce0.example_simple: They live on the outskirts of the city.
pubcol-w-856ecce135a89ce0.example_complex: New housing estates are spreading rapidly on the outskirts of the city as property prices in the centre soar.

pubcol-w-d8652df75faef5b4.definition_en: immediately and at the place where something is happening
pubcol-w-d8652df75faef5b4.example_simple: She answered the question on the spot.
pubcol-w-d8652df75faef5b4.example_complex: Impressed by his portfolio, the director offered him the job on the spot without waiting for further interviews.

pubcol-w-724b276a9db48f0c.definition_en: very close to no longer existing as a species
collocations: a species on the verge of extinction
push on the verge of extinction
animals on the verge of extinction
pubcol-w-724b276a9db48f0c.example_simple: The tiger is on the verge of extinction in this region.
pubcol-w-724b276a9db48f0c.example_complex: Decades of habitat loss have driven the rhinoceros on the verge of extinction, prompting urgent conservation efforts.

pubcol-w-7e0fcea80ef2280f.definition_en: generally speaking; taking everything into account
pubcol-w-7e0fcea80ef2280f.example_simple: On the whole, the trip was a success.
pubcol-w-7e0fcea80ef2280f.example_complex: There were a few minor complaints, but on the whole the customers were satisfied with the new service.

pubcol-w-50a773e20ba750e0.definition_en: away from work or school, taking a holiday
pubcol-w-50a773e20ba750e0.example_simple: They are on vacation in Italy.
pubcol-w-50a773e20ba750e0.example_complex: While he was on vacation, his colleagues covered his shifts so he could relax without checking his email.

pubcol-w-4ac61a5087d3a6fa.definition_en: at the point of doing something or of something happening very soon
collocations: on the verge of doing something
pubcol-w-4ac61a5087d3a6fa.example_simple: She was on the verge of tears.
pubcol-w-4ac61a5087d3a6fa.example_complex: The company was on the verge of bankruptcy when an unexpected investor stepped in to rescue it.

pubcol-w-7cf8710d14e7d699.example_simple: We eat out once in a while.
pubcol-w-7cf8710d14e7d699.example_complex: Once in a while she treats herself to a weekend away, but for the most part she prefers a quiet routine at home.
